message: REV-1 [R2] Upgrading changes the look for apps that pass no theme. An app that overrides the colour variables on :root (as the docs advise) now loses those overrides for the mobile cards, spinner and messages, because the wrapper redefines every variable. To stay non-breaking, the light defaults should be overridable from outside, for example by using :where() to give the defaults zero specificity and a custom-property layering scheme, or by reading app overrides first. Add a test showing that a :root override still wins.

REV-2 [R4] The migration advice does not run as written: following the ':root' option leaves the app's colours unchanged. The note also treats a visible behaviour change as 'additive, no breaking changes'. Fix the advice, or fix the CSS so :root really works (see the R2 finding).

REV-3 [R3] The theme change must not alter layout. The wrapper should be layout-neutral (for example display: contents, or pass-through width/height/flex) and a test should cover it. Without that, upgrading can change layout for apps that opt into nothing.
REV-4 [UI-001] Use style={{ fill: 'var(--rt-nodata-icon-color, #ccc)' }} or fill="currentColor" with a colour on the parent, as the design itself described.
REV-5 [UI-001] Use rem for the radii in the newly added error-panel classes. The values were px before as inline styles, so this is minor.
REV-6 [UI-001] Formatting only. Run the project's prettier/format script on the touched files.

QA-1 [R3] R3 acceptance lines have no test that could fail: 'in the dark look no part shows the light background / dark-on-dark text', 'custom variables such as --table-header-bg still apply', and 'light look visually unchanged'. Also the edge case 'skeleton, spinner and detail rows are checked in the dark look' is only checked as 'inside the wrapper', not as dark colours. Add a test that asserts the dark and light variable sets exist and differ (for example parse Theme.module.css, check every variable the table uses is defined in both looks, and that no non-variable light hex colours remain in the module CSS used by these parts). Also assert that an app-level override of --table-header-bg is not shadowed by the wrapper.
QA-2 [R3] Add an automated check of text/background variable pairs against 4.5:1 and borders/focus against 3:1 for both looks. There is no example-page check either.

QA-3 [R1] The R1 edge case says scroll position, selection, sort and expanded rows are preserved on theme change, and the performance NFR says scroll is not reset. The node-identity check only partly proves this. A stronger test would select a row, sort, expand and scroll before the rerender.

QA-4 [R1] The reliability NFR asks for no hydration mismatch warning with theme='system' or body.dark, and for React 18 and 19 support. Only the SSR-string path for system is proven. Light-first rendering followed by an effect makes mismatch unlikely, but it is not tested.

QA-5 [R4] Docs content (the examples running as written, page links, the 'default is light' and 'explicit prop wins' statements) has no automated proof. The test that tags R4 for 'explicit prop wins over body.dark' proves behaviour, not docs. A review of docs is needed. The packed-library check and release-notes size note are not evidenced.
